verdict.headline: Rey Cortiço Early morning — 08:00
verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for early morning — 08:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: For TOMORROW, I’d check the cameras first—Rey Cortiço around the early morning window is the best bet on paper, but Surfline looks only poor to fair and the wind angle for that exposed north setup isn’t great. Tide is low and dropping, so it could still line up well if the sandbanks are behaving, but it’s definitely a “rare window” type of call. I’d look at Surfline and MEO Beachcam before leaving and only go if it looks clearly cleaner than expected.
